text: Public budgets are always limited, and every tenge spent on a theatre is a tenge that is not spent on a hospital. Nevertheless, I largely agree that governments should continue to fund the arts, because culture brings benefits that the market alone would not provide.

The case for prioritising essential services is certainly strong. Healthcare and education affect every citizen directly, and in countries where hospitals are short of equipment or schools are overcrowded, spending on opera or modern art can seem difficult to defend. Critics also point out that the arts often serve a relatively small, well-educated audience, which raises questions of fairness.

However, the arts are far from being a luxury with no practical value. Museums, theatres and festivals attract tourists and create jobs, often generating more income for a city than they cost. More importantly, culture shapes national identity and gives people a shared experience of their history and values. Without public support, many forms of art that are not commercially profitable, such as classical music or traditional folk performance, would struggle to survive and could disappear altogether.

The fairness argument can also be addressed. Rather than cutting funding, governments can make culture more accessible, for example by offering free museum entry on certain days or cheaper tickets for students, so that public money benefits a wider section of society rather than a privileged few.

In conclusion, although essential services must always come first, I believe that a modest and well-targeted budget for the arts is a sensible use of public money, since it supports both the economy and the cultural life of a nation.

strengths.en: The writer presents the other side fully and fairly, which makes the position more credible.
strengths.kk: Автор қарсыластардың дәлелдерін адал әрі толық баяндайды — бұл ұстанымға сенімді арттырады.

strengths.ru: More importantly показывает, какой довод главный, — это Coherence band 8.

strengths.en: The writer answers the counter-argument with a practical proposal.
strengths.kk: Автор қарсы дәлелге практикалық ұсыныспен жауап береді.
strengths.ru: Автор отвечает на контраргумент практическим предложением.

title.en: A solution, not just a debate

note.en: Introduction: accepting that budgets are limited and a “largely agree” position with a reason.
note.kk: Кіріспе: бюджеттің шектеулі екенін мойындау және себебі бар «негізінен келісемін» ұстанымы.
note.ru: Введение: признание ограниченности бюджета и позиция «в основном согласен» с причиной.

note.en: The strength of the other side: the direct value of health and education and the question of fairness.
note.kk: Қарсыластардың күшті жағы: медицина мен білімнің тікелей пайдасы және әділдік мәселесі.
note.ru: Сильная сторона противников: прямая польза медицины и образования и вопрос справедливости.

note.en: The main arguments for: the economy, identity, the survival of non-commercial art.
note.kk: Басты «жақтайтын» дәлелдер: экономика, бірегейлік, коммерциялық емес өнердің сақталуы.
note.ru: Главные доводы «за»: экономика, идентичность, выживание некоммерческого искусства.

note.en: An answer to the fairness point: make culture accessible rather than cut it.
note.kk: Әділдік дәлеліне жауап: мәдениетті қысқартпай, қолжетімдірек ету.
note.ru: Ответ на довод о справедливости: сделать культуру доступнее, а не урезать.

note.en: Conclusion: a concession and a position refined to “a modest, well-targeted budget”.
note.kk: Қорытынды: мойындау және «қарапайым әрі мақсатты бюджет» нақтылауы бар ұстаным.
note.ru: Вывод: уступка и позиция с уточнением «скромный и целевой бюджет».
